name: Twixxel's Stalker (Fabric)
description: Unofficial Fabric port of Twixxel's Stalker for Minecraft 1.21.11. Adds The Stalker, a silent hunter that pursues you when you're not looking. Original mod by MrPerkasc (idea by Twixxel_lesgo, designs by LCrandom); this Fabric port is maintained by Thiov and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original authors.
